description: This file defines request handlers for Text-to-Speech (TTS) related operations in a server context, including status checks, enabling/disabling TTS, converting text to speech, setting providers, and listing providers. It imports configuration, provider registry, TTS functionalities, protocol error handling, and logging utilities.

methods.name: ttsHandlers['tts.status']
methods.description: Handles status requests for TTS, including checking if TTS is enabled, auto mode status, provider info, fallback providers, and provider states.

methods.name: ttsHandlers['tts.enable']
methods.description: Enables TTS by setting the enabled flag to true in the preferences.

methods.name: ttsHandlers['tts.disable']
methods.description: Disables TTS by setting the enabled flag to false.

methods.name: ttsHandlers['tts.convert']
methods.description: Converts given text to speech, returning the audio path and provider info if successful.

methods.name: ttsHandlers['tts.setProvider']
methods.description: Sets the current TTS provider based on the provided provider id.

methods.name: ttsHandlers['tts.providers']
methods.description: Lists available TTS providers, their configurations, models, and voices.

ctags.name: channel
ctags.pattern: /^      const channel = typeof params.channel === "string" ? params.channel.trim() : undefined;$/

ctags.name: params
ctags.pattern: /^      const channel = typeof params.channel === "string" ? params.channel.trim() : undefined;$/

ctags.name: result
ctags.pattern: /^      const result = await textToSpeech({ text, cfg, channel });$/
